prose: AI21 describes how it uses Kueue on GKE to share a roughly 10,000-GPU fleet across teams, which Google Cloud credits with an 83% cut in time-to-start for high-priority workloads. The post is a technical case study from one shared cluster. Only the opening was read.
highlights: Kueue schedules a shared GPU fleet on GKE.
83% reduction in time-to-start for high-priority jobs.
